name: Truce
overview: The Scripture passage in 2 Samuel 2:26-31 presents a moment of truce amid conflict, where Abner appeals to Joab to cease the bloodshed, recognizing the lasting bitterness of continual warfare. Joab responds with a solemn oath that, but for Abner's intervention, the fighting would have continued until morning. The blowing of the trumpet signals the halt of battle, allowing Abner and his men to withdraw safely. This account highlights the reality of warfare in biblical times but also reveals God's providence in restraining violence through human agency, underscoring the value of peace even in the midst of conflict.
